# Import photos without losing your place.

> Resumable, manifest-backed command-line tools that import JPEG and RAW photos into Apple Photos and offload SD cards with hash verification.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
